description: This Java source file defines the 'Exec' utility class for executing shell commands, capturing output streams, handling timeouts, and managing process lifecycle within an Android application.

classes.name: Exec
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to run shell commands and process their output streams with timeout and cancellation support.

methods.name: runForStream
methods.description: Executes a shell command, returns its InputStream, and manages process timeout and cancellation.

methods.name: runForStrings
methods.description: Executes a shell command, captures its output lines into a String array, with timeout and cancellation handling.
